statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); project_root=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "no-git"); tar_project=$(grep -m1 '^TAR_PROJECT=' "$project_root/.Renviron" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); project_suffix=$([ -n "$tar_project" ] && echo " {$tar_project}" || echo ""); git_dir=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); git_common=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); wt_marker=$([ "$git_dir" = "$git_common" ] && echo "" || echo "*"); echo "$model [$branch$wt_marker] ${ctx}%$project_suffix"
